name: upright-caddy
why: The envelope judged the only way it can be: 20 x 22 x 60 into 70 x 22 x 20 fits, because turning an axis-aligned box inside an axis-aligned box can only permute its three extents, so the best orientation pairs largest with largest. Axis for axis the part is 40 mm too tall and the verdict would be `over`, which is the answer a reader does the arithmetic for and gets wrong. The volume is the kernel's: the four upright edges are rounded at 3 mm, so what the part uses is not the 13.856 cm3 the two boxes give. `meets` is held word for word.
